# Pedalmoto

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bicycle shop from Granada with an online store on PrestaShop. Sells bicycles, e-bikes, components, clothing, helmets, accessories and nutrition. Its delivery page states free shipping thresholds for the Peninsula, Balearic Islands and Portugal and says shipping outside the Peninsula is quoted on request.
